paths.outcomes: outcomes/<sha256(id)>.json (complete or attention; no automatic retry)
paths.resume_requests: resumes/<slotname>/<request_id>.json (root-created append-only control request; request_id matches [A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,200})
paths.resume_receipts: sessions/<slotname>/resume_receipts/<request_id>.json (exclusive append-only decision); changed consumed bytes use changed_<sha256(request_id bytes + NUL + observed request SHA256 ASCII)>.json, a fixed 77-byte rejection filename; receipt body retains the complete original request_id

semantics.technical_task_failure: attention_holding; original valid cases unchanged; no automatic retry; keeper/lease retained
semantics.keeper_or_ownership_failure: fatal_attention; no more tasks; inherited global flock retained until root release; context loss reported honestly
semantics.explicit_release: at task boundary record release_requested; reap only owned server/worker children, close keeper control writer, wait for keeper process exit; only then write output/complete.json and exit0. Cleanup failure retains global flock/fatal_attention and retries release cleanup.
semantics.parent_death: control EOF; keeper releases its own allocation/context; writer is never passed to server/worker
semantics.activation: must be campaign/transactions/<tx>/committed.json, matching schema and exact task byte SHA256
semantics.source_policy: plan immutable; source pins verified before task; original frozen read_manifest(verify_sources=True) and all scientific gates remain real
semantics.dynamic_outputs: not implemented; only fixed discovery/confirmation roots; unsupported tasks cause attention hold, never automatic session exit
semantics.pid_namespace: compute query PID recorded as unresolved namespace; never signalled/equated to local PID; admission is live owned Driver keeper plus sole bounded compute consistency
semantics.science_environment: only current original empty non-resource env accepted; scientific environment is frozen runner.environment() plus identical assigned GPU/EGL settings
semantics.operator_SIGTERM_SIGINT: set attention request; finish current science task, then retain keeper/global lease without taking new tasks; only root release file exits
semantics.explicit_resume: At attention/fatal hold boundaries inspect this slot resume inbox. Only nonfatal attention can be cleared. Revalidate exact request plan/PID/start/UUID/attention/reason, original keeper live, all science children reaped, exact fresh scheduler/session identity and inherited lease path/device/inode/FD set, immutable plan/source pins and assigned sole-small keeper consistency. Re-read exact request bytes before durable receipt. Keep the same keeper/control writer/global lease; original attention outcomes remain byte-identical and old task IDs remain skipped. Scientific retry requires root to publish a new activated descriptor/ID.
semantics.resume_refusal: Invalid/stale/foreign/source-changed requests get rejected append-only receipts and preserve attention without releasing. Fatal/keeperless/unverified ownership cannot resume. Existing fatal keeper-loss handling remains active. A consumed ID is never replayed; changed bytes create a separate rejected audit and require a new request ID. A receipt-write failure cannot clear attention. Explicit release files retain priority.

review_notes: Resource execution revision is added to original identity/result/marker artifacts; scientific runtime revision and original server/worker command schema preserved.
Original valid cases are validated via frozen completed/recover_case and skipped.
No scheduler, gate, keeper or frozen scientific source is modified by this module.
This session retains a context/allocation, not exclusive whole-device enforcement against external users.

validation.real_frozen_pure_prepare: Passed actual read_manifest(verify_sources=True), validate_output/planned_config/cases and runner.run(launch=False), yielded original120-case server/worker argv. No keeper/driver/GPU query/result writes.
validation.resume_cpu_tests: 9 additional CPU fake groups: same keeper/lease and next descriptor, old outcomes immutable/no rerun, strict request/source/binding/children/scan refusals, fatal/keepergone, one-use/changed bytes, scan-time mutation and receipt I/O failure, malformed/symlink requests and append-only receipts, missing session source still records exact rejected request hash, 200-character request ID receives a bounded changed-bytes rejection audit.
validation.campaign_recovery_cpu_tests: Includes fake manifest_reader injection; duplicate logical A omitting B with recomputed legal hashes; condition/stage/output/shard/env/hash/completion-field changes despite unchanged argv; reject queue prepends/reorders/nonjobs metadata changes; allow tail appends and supersede pre-CAS format-only queue changes.

resume_request.reason: Nonempty root review reason; no additional request fields accepted

resume_receipt.request_sha256: SHA256 of exact observed request bytes
resume_receipt.source_proof: verified boolean, actual session source SHA256 and plan SHA256; successful proof additionally includes verified source_hashes, fresh inherited scheduler lease binding, original keeper ready identity and sole-small assigned-GPU consistency
